purpose: Explicación visual del RAG previsto; no evidencia de implementación
prompt:
Create a polished Spanish explanatory infographic bitmap for CampusFlow's website, inspired by the reference diagrams' information flow, but a completely new design aligned with Campuslands. Wide landscape 16:9, generous space, very legible exact Spanish text, large Poppins-like sans-serif typography. Flat near-black graphite background #111111, panels #1A1A1A, white #E9E9E9 text, strong blue #56B4FF connectors, restrained teal #54C6AA only for verified sources. Professional editorial technical diagram, crisp consistent thin-line document/database/search/message icons, no people, no gradients, no glow, no decorative noise. Heading exact "Cómo funcionará el RAG de CampusFlow". Small subtitle exact "Arquitectura prevista · implementación pendiente".
Two clearly separated numbered horizontal lanes with arrows that never cross labels:
Top lane heading "1. Preparar las fuentes". Four evenly spaced nodes left to right: "PDF y Excel autorizados", then "Extraer y dividir", then "Crear embeddings", then "Índice vectorial". Under the first node small "Simulados: identificar como demo". Under extraction small "Página, hoja y versión". Under embeddings small "Proveedor por definir". Under index small "Permisos por documento".
Bottom lane heading "2. Responder con evidencia". Five nodes left to right: "Tu pregunta", "Validar permisos", "Buscar fragmentos", "Generar con contexto", "Respuesta con citas". Each node icon and short readable title. The "Índice vectorial" top lane feeds "Buscar fragmentos" bottom lane through a clean vertical elbow arrow without crossing text. Bottom lane only shows question retrieval, not arbitrary tools/actions. Under generation small "LLM / Groq". Under answer small "Página o fila de origen".
Bottom full-width footer text exact "Sin evidencia, no se inventa una respuesta." and beneath in small clearly legible text "La disponibilidad se valida en PostgreSQL. El RAG no asigna recursos." This image explains a PLANNED architecture and must not claim the RAG is already running. Do not include fake throughput, percentages, a live chatbot or user data. No external logos. Ref diagrams are conceptual structure references only, not copy their illustrations.
